system:
You repair one knowledge atom that auditors sent back. Use only the supplied evidence sentences; add no background knowledge.

Rules for the repaired atoms:
- One independently assessable claim per atom, written as one sentence that is understood without the source.
- If the atom joined several claims, split it into separate atoms (at most 3), most important first.
- Every atom must be fully stated in the evidence sentences it cites. Remove anything the evidence does not state. Keep quantifiers, negation, hedges, and formulas (LaTeX in $...$).
- Remove procedural or evaluative add-ons and stacked conditions; keep a condition only if the claim is false without it.
- Drop attributions such as "the authors state" when the claim itself is general.
- Use the S label that fits: S1 what it is / S2 how it works / S3 where it ends.
- If no valid atom can be written from this evidence, return an empty list and explain in note.

Output ONLY one JSON object:
{"atoms": [{"statement": "...", "scope": "S1|S2|S3", "evidence_ids": ["..."]}], "note": ""}
user:
CONCEPT: CAR structure

ATOM CART-C03-S3-03 (S3): Fourth-generation CAR-T cells (armoured CAR cells or TRUCKs), which encode a CAR plus a cytokine, interleukin, pro-inflammatory ligand, or chemokine to counteract the immune suppressive microenvironment of most solid tumours, have so far been developed for preclinical projects.

EVIDENCE:
[CART-p0013-s05] Finally, fourth generation CAR-T cells have been developed for preclinical projects.
[CART-p0013-s06] These cells, named armoured CAR cells or T cells redirected for universal cytokine-mediated killing (TRUCKS), encode not only a CAR (usually with one costimulatory domain, such as in second generation CARs) but also a cytokine, interleukin, pro-inflammatory ligand, or chemokine that will counteract the immune suppressive microenvironment that prevails in most solid tumours (Eshhar et al. 1993; Chmielewski and Abken 2015).

AUDITOR FINDINGS:
- GROUNDED: hold — Delete “so far,” which implies development remains confined to preclinical projects; the evidence only states development for preclinical projects.
- SINGLE_CLAIM: revise — Names, additional payload architecture, microenvironmental purpose, and preclinical development status are independently assessable. / Combines the structural definition/mechanism of 4th-generation CARs with their current preclinical development status.
- SCOPE_LABEL: hold — S1/S2: Defines fourth-generation CARs (TRUCKs) and their mechanism, rather than a boundary/limitation.
- L1_ONLY: revise — Retain the defining additional payload; separate aliases, microenvironmental effects, and development status. / Remove the time-bound preclinical development status add-on.
- SOURCE_INDEPENDENT: hold — “So far” makes development status depend on an unspecified source-era cutoff rather than a fixed conceptual fact. / Drop 'have so far been developed for preclinical projects', which is time-bound to the publication date.
raw: {"atoms": [{"statement": "Fourth-generation CAR-T cells, called armoured CAR cells or TRUCKs, encode a CAR (usually with one costimulatory domain, as in second-generation CARs) together with a cytokine, interleukin, pro-inflammatory ligand, or chemokine.", "scope": "S1", "evidence_ids": ["CART-p0013-s06"]}, {"statement": "In fourth-generation CAR-T cells (TRUCKs), the encoded cytokine, interleukin, pro-inflammatory ligand, or chemokine is intended to counteract the immune suppressive microenvironment that prevails in most solid tumours.", "scope": "S2", "evidence_ids": ["CART-p0013-s06"]}], "note": "Removed 'so far' and the preclinical-status claim as time-bound; split definition from mechanism and relabelled from S3 to S1/S2."}
